posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
"Crazy Jane and the Lizard" I guess maybe I have a thing about blondes and critters. BB640 4X5 plate, 660 nm laser diode, TEA swelling (note the squeegee streaks at the lower left corner), Optiled amber lighting (source laserreflections.com)

![Image](http://members.shaw.ca/holopix/pics/crazyjane.jpg)

For those unfamiliar with the Crazy Jane mythos, here's a poem:

Crazy Jane on God

That lover of a night

Came when he would,

Went in the dawning light

Whether I would or no;

Men come, men go;

All things remain in God.

Banners choke the sky;

Men-at-arms tread;

Armoured horses neigh

In the narrow pass:

All things remain in God.

Before their eyes a house

That from childhood stood

Uninhabited, ruinous,

Suddenly lit up

From door to top:

All things remain in God.

I had wild Jack for a lover;

Though like a road

That men pass over

My body makes no moan

But sings on:

All things remain in God.

W.B. Yeats - from The Winding Stair and Other Poems, 1933

How much gel on the hair?

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
Gee, I didn't think to use gel or spray - it might have helped to stabilize her unmanageable, fly-away hair.

Re the lizard, all my characters inhabit a many-worlds multiverse and in this thread, the lizard lives to a ripe old age.
